description: A static call of a namespaced function gives the name joined with double colons
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and gives them joined with :: as the static call's name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go, FunctionCallExpr.ExprCall in hclsyntax/expression.go).
